speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the severity and duration of your itching, and have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis, do you currently notice any changes in your bowel movements, such as diarrhea or blood, and have you observed any darkening of your urine or pale-colored stools?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of ulcerative colitis and the presence of scleral icterus, I need to rule out primary sclerosing cholangitis. REQUEST TEST: MRCP

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the MRCP is normal, I need to distinguish between other causes of cholestasis like primary biliary cholangitis or drug-induced injury. REQUEST TEST: Anti-mitochondrial antibodies, Anti-nuclear antibodies, and Serum IgG4

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Anti-Nuclear_Antibody: Negative, Antimitochondrial_Antibodies: Negative, Serum IgG4: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: With autoimmune causes largely ruled out, I need to investigate infectious etiologies given your sexual history. REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis B surface antigen, Hepatitis C antibody, and Hepatitis A IgM

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative infectious and autoimmune workup, I need to assess for other causes of cholestasis or drug-induced liver injury. Have you started any new medications, supplements, or herbal remedies in the past few months, and do you consume alcohol regularly?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, Ulcerative Colitis Social history: Sexually active with inconsistent condom use

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned you have hypertension; could you list all the specific medications you are currently taking for that condition and any other regular prescriptions? I also need to know if you have experienced any right upper quadrant pain or fever.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, diarrhea, joint pain, or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that clarification. Since infectious, autoimmune, and structural causes have been largely ruled out, I need to assess for metabolic or genetic liver diseases. REQUEST TEST: Serum ferritin, Transferrin saturation, Ceruloplasmin, and Alpha-1 antitrypsin level

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Liver biopsy shows chronic cholangitis with bile duct loss and periductal fibrosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The liver biopsy findings of chronic cholangitis with bile duct loss and periductal fibrosis, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis, are classic for Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis, even though the initial MRCP was normal. DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis
